newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy and wheat mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy and wheat mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn, soybean and wheat basis values were mostly steady on Monday, starting off the week in dull activity, U.S. export sources said.
Dealer cited a continued lack of export activity and scant farmer sales.

In export news, Sri Lanka bought 50,000 tonnes of optional-origin soft wheat at around $162 per tonne including freight, European exporters said. The purchase, carried out last week, is for wheat of any origin but the grain could be supplied from Britain. Shipment is due from February.
